title: A Proposal for Evaluating the Operational Risk for ChatBots based on Large Language Models
authors: Pedro Pinacho-Davidson; Fernando Gutierrez; Pablo Zapata; Rodolfo Vergara; Pablo Aqueveque
why_relevant: Proposes a generic operational risk metric for LLM chatbots, demonstrated on RAG systems, touching on prompt injection and misinformation risks.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on a general cybersecurity risk scoring framework for chatbots, not on RAG-specific robustness, retrieval noise, conflict, or calibration.
